title: Yes, I Use AI to Make My Game | A Solo Dev Responds to the Hate
author: JustAGirlInSpace2

comments.author: fisj
comments.body: Approving this post. This got flagged for essentially \_only\_ complaining about Anti AI sentiment, which we're cracking down on. However the long form format of youtube videos allows more nuanced discussions and a quick review of the video I see it talks process.

comments.author: JustAGirlInSpace2
comments.body: I don't own the video, but I wanted to share it here on the sub.😃

comments.author: Comet7777
comments.body:
Reminds me a lot of this one too: https://youtu.be/HOflOoRd4V8?is=r3WoukQWyBRFNVd9

comments.author: zenmatrix83
comments.body: no one here makes games any more, now we are making videos about ai hate,.... make good games and this would all go away, keep producing low quality games it gives them ammo to throw back at you

replies.author: Tkwan777
replies.body: Even with AI assistance, its going to take a year or more for the good ones to come out. Pro studios could probably pop out large games in roughly year also since they have large teams that can all use ai in their various departments.

replies.author: zenmatrix83
replies.body: yet people still put out very low quality rushed items. usually the honest ones admit the pushed it too much,  I'm just saying take time do the best you can. Consistency isn't that hard to do but  when you just go "Ai make me game" then "Ai add this feature" its not going to work unless you go back and test and actually play and review your game looking for problems.  Lots of  people are still too impressed on what AI can do and don't take time to smooth out rough edges, and get offended when people point them out. I'm as far as anti ai as you can get, but a good portion of the ones Is ee are poor and its not the models fault

replies.author: Lambisexual
replies.body: Every single "I made this totally-not-copy of popular game" or "here's my 2 minute walking simulator with free to download assets" gives people another full round of ammunition of hate. I wish people were harsher on blatant copies or walking simulators without any gameplay. Cause this is what people who are on the fence or in opposition are gonna be exposed to.

comments.author: mrpoopistan
comments.body:
Worth remembering that Chinese bot farms fan AI hate to hold back US development.

Except for the most "bro, did you even try stuff," I see very little direct hatred for AI-assisted games when I venture into other subs. For example, I can see the hallmarks of AI in a decent amount of the games that people promote on r/sciencefiction, and none of those threads erupt with AI hatred.

The most grassroots hatred tends to come from creative subs, and a lot of those are justified by the general badness of AI for those tasks, such as drawing and writing.

comments.author: SalivaSpittingWorm
comments.body: Just tell them that, friend! I agree with you!

comments.author: CoolTIOnline
comments.body:
I started building my first game on a whim, which was something I always wanted to do and as I started using Godot and Claude's help, I have gone so far and built something so fun that I can't wait to release... only in the last month or so I came to reddit to advertise in different groups and holy crap did I see how much the use of AI is hated on certain groups. I get it, I understand the issues that come with the use of AI.  
However AI is a tool and it enables people who have vision and who wish to realize their dream, their passion and put in serious work into it... they can make something awesome and at that point, that person is a Game Dev and an Artist as he has realized his vision.

comments.author: D3c1m470r
comments.body:
Thanks for putting this out there.   
I hope it gets watched by all those haters who probably never going to understand that being a solo-dev is just so incredibly involving and would be impossible for most of us without these tools.  
I usually use the metaphor - are you also hating on mathematicians for using a calculator instead of hand-writing everything?

comments.author: Special_Eye4266
comments.body:
Ai IS a tool, not an automatic slop machine. Just like any other practice, an artist could take a paint brush and fling paint at it randomly or they can use their brush with precision and care to create the detail that their imagination desires. People are so caught up on capabilities that they rush before understanding the tool itself. Can you imagine if a stone sculptor  took a chisel and attempted to “one shot” an entire stone slab?

Honestly it almost feels like these days people just expect AI to be that creative part of the project too and form even the concept of what the game should be. The problem is, there is no passion then and you lack direction. The project is simply going to come out lackluster and problematic as would any other hobby or skill.

the work that you put in is the work you get out of AI

comments.author: dustandwater
comments.body:
Hey. Do you realise that “synonymous with” means the same as “interchangeable with”? 

So, you’re saying that “indie = slop”. I doubt that’s what you meant?

Perhaps you meant to say associated with?

replies.author: Stinky_You
replies.body: Did you stop reading there just to say that?

replies.author: dustandwater
replies.body: I didn’t stop reading. I actually agree with your sentiments. I just thought you might like to know what that phrase means for next time you use it. If not, feel free to ignore me.

replies.author: Stinky_You
replies.body: You misunderstood it entirely if you're under the impression I used it out of place or incorrectly. Doesn't really matter to me if you read it again correctly or not

replies.author: dustandwater
replies.body: Oh, okay. I guess we don’t share sentiments then, if you actually did intend to claim that indie games are synonymous with slop, i.e. all indie games are always slop. I definitely don’t agree with that. I really thought there was no way that you meant to make that claim. I also thought your own comment later clarified against that claim. But if you did, you do you, I guess.

replies.author: Stinky_You
replies.body: Were just as synonymous with slop as AI is now. Bro get it together. If you're going to consistently read it out of context don't even bother commenting. Run it through ai so you can get the full context if you're even capable of that, before you go running your mouth. I was pretty clear at the end that some of my favorite games are indie.

replies.author: dustandwater
replies.body:
Look. If you have any interest in using the phrase “synonymous with” correctly, then now you know. If you wish to continue using it incorrectly, of course you absolutely can do that.

In your comment, you wrote: “I’m a firm believer that indie was synonymous with slop long before AI was” and you then wrote: “I’m not saying indie games are all garbage.”

I know you’re saying you like indie games. That’s my point. That’s why your use of “synonymous with” was incorrect. 

I’m just pointing out that these two sentences are inconsistent. But I’ll leave that with you for now. Proceed as you wish.

replies.author: dustandwater
replies.body: That’s precisely why I’m teaching you 8th grade vocabulary.

replies.author: CoolTIOnline
replies.body:
As much as his un-eddited post (without the clarification) did sound pretty bashing on Indie title, I didn't necessarily get the impression he meant all Indie games.  
It is true, that long before AI, on the Indie side of games there have always been a stupidly large amount of crap, especially in the Mobile Phone games department. Still today I refuse to play a mobile phone game. I rather carry around an 8 bit gameboy or may chinisium rom thing which actually works pretty nicely. However the fact is there has always been gold too. Back to my original point. AI just makes it so much easier and faster to release and in my opinion it's a good thing because more quality stuff will also come of it as long as people play test and support the craps out of it.  
(I hope to release a demo of my game this week)

comments.author: Lumpy_Conference6640
comments.body: I've had this same argument, in the same words, too many times. I'm just so weirded out.

comments.author: CoolTIOnline
comments.body:
I am at least grateful for the occasional gold that gets released.  
At some point me and 3 or 4 friends would take 1-2 hours a week to play some multiplayer games... and we are all in our 40's, all married and most of them have kids too so... stage of life where gaming usually dies. Anyways, 2 indie games that I have to say were outstanding fun... Barotrauma and Lethal Company... both got us laughing till it hurt as if we were 16 again. For single player gold I have to say FTL tops my list. Specially with it's Multiverse mod.  
Btw, as soon as I release my demo, I will have to send you a link. You seem like a pretty strong opinionated guy who calls it the way you see it and I appreciate constructive criticism.
